description.en: The ID of the region where the cloud computers are located. This parameter filters the results to include only cloud computers in the specified region.

description.zh:
需要查询的任务类型。仅有定时类任务可以查询到批次信息。

- TimerBoot：定时开机
- TimerShutdown：定时关机
- TimerReboot：定时重启
- TimerReset：定时重置
- TimerMaintenance：定时进入维护模式
- TimerHibernate：定时休眠
description.en:
The type of the scheduled task. This operation returns batch information for timer-based scheduled tasks only.

- `TimerBoot`: scheduled startup

- `TimerShutdown`: scheduled shutdown

- `TimerReboot`: scheduled reboot

- `TimerReset`: scheduled reset

- `TimerMaintenance`: scheduled maintenance

- `TimerHibernate`: scheduled hibernation

title.zh: 查询定时任务执行批次列表
title.en: Query the list of scheduled task execution batches

descriptions.zh: - 此接口为中心化域名，接入点为上海或新加坡，不支持其他地域调用。
descriptions.en: - This API uses a centralized endpoint. You can call this API only from the China (Shanghai) or Singapore (Singapore) regions.
